like him.

Salmon du Salad!\pLes guests may gripe it's fish\nagain, however!

“The lovely and sweet\nCLEFAIRY”

The sea is great and all, but I\nlike the mountains, too.
Hey, stop!\pI found these fossils!\nThey're both mine!
Okay!\nI'll share!
We'll each take a fossil!\nNo being greedy!
All right.\nThen this fossil is mine!

We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the\nfossils!\pReviving POKéMON from them will\nearn us huge riches!
Urgh!\nNow I'm mad!

I'm steamed!

Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?
Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?

Obtained the DOME FOSSIL!

using the move CUT.\pBut remember this!

discarded.

may be hidden from view.\pUse the ITEMFINDER to detect any
hidden items close to you.\pThe machine is a bit limited.
It can't pinpoint item locations.\pWhat it does is show the direction
where the item is.\pUse it to get your bearings, then
search the suspect area by hand.

route to take.

up good names for POKéMON?\pEspecially if you've caught a
whole bunch?\pIn LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man
who rates POKéMON nicknames.\pHe can even help you rename your
POKéMON, too.
If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER\nTOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.\pYou can get to ROCK TUNNEL from\nCERULEAN CITY.

Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!

Hello, stranger!\pI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\pAll my POKéMON are from the sea.
Darn!\nI let that one get away!
I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!
My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!\pHe has enough STRENGTH to move\nbig rocks!

policy about POKéMON can turn pro.\pWhat is your approach when you
catch and train POKéMON?\pMy policy is an all-out offensive
with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

The CASCADEBADGE makes all
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey.\pThat includes even outsiders you
got in trades.\pThere's more. You can now use CUT
anytime, even out of battle.\pYou can CUT down small trees to
open new pathways.\pYou can also have my favorite TM.
{PLAYER} received TM03\nfrom MISTY.
You better make room for this!

You overwhelmed me!
You have to face other TRAINERS\nto see how good you really are.
Splash!\pI'm first up!\nLet's do it!
MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\pShe won't lose to someone like you!

GRASS-type POKéMON.\pOr, you might use ELECTRIC-type
POKéMON and zap them!
